discription: A basic Frequency Modulation (FM) synthesizer with carrier and modulator oscillators, providing a range of bell-like or metallic tones. Parameters control carrier-to-modulator frequency ratios and modulation depth (index).
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, carRatio=1.0, modRatio=1.0, index=1.0;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var modulator = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio) * (freq * index);    var carrier = SinOsc.ar(freq * carRatio + modulator);    var sig = carrier * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
